comment: Flange per the BT30 standard (JIS B 6339 / ISO 7388-1, flange 46 mm); the body and nose are a conservative generic envelope for collision checks; nose: ER20 collet nut about 34 mm across (ISO 15488 ER20 collets). Measure your own holders and correct the segments.
name: BT30 ER20 collet chuck, 60 mm gauge
